## Send RFQ (Sr)

Flips a draft RFQ to `sent` after checking it is actually sendable (≥1 line, ≥1 invited vendor). Single-persona rule: no vendor delivery channel — "sending" marks the ask issued; the buyer transmits it outside the system and records inbound quotes themselves.

### Example

Natural target: the linked RFQ "Q1 Laptop Refresh" (already past `sent`, now comparing).

### Non-goals

No email/portal integration; no reminder scheduling.
